title: Prototype emergency-routing policy
source: PT Zero authored demo policy v1
text: Configured emergency warning signs must stop automated provider ranking and escalate to local emergency assistance. This demonstration rule is not a complete clinical triage protocol.

title: Skin-care navigation
source: PT Zero authored demo navigation note v1
text: Persistent non-emergency skin concerns may be assessed by general practice or dermatology. The application recommends a care category and does not determine a diagnosis.

title: Headache-care navigation
source: PT Zero authored demo navigation note v1
text: Recurring non-emergency headaches may begin with general practice assessment, with neurology as a relevant specialty when clinically appropriate.

title: Musculoskeletal-care navigation
source: PT Zero authored demo navigation note v1
text: Non-emergency joint and mobility concerns may involve general practice, physiotherapy, or orthopaedic services depending on professional assessment.

title: Mental-health navigation
source: PT Zero authored demo navigation note v1
text: People seeking non-emergency anxiety or stress support may consider general practice or psychology services. Urgent safety concerns require immediate human support.

title: General care-navigation policy
source: PT Zero authored demo policy v1
text: When the available information does not clearly match a specialty, the prototype uses general practice as its default navigation category.
